job.name: ig19_cover
job.style: A finished, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER: a photorealistic dark green school chalkboard filling the whole frame, with a clean white chalk line drawing of a simple wooden chair in the middle, like the attached image; one small bolt on the chair joint is circled with a bright red-orange chalk circle and an arrow. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian chalk-style typography is REQUIRED and is the only text, at the TOP part of the board: a large white chalk line «САМАЯ ВАЖНАЯ ЧАСТЬ», under it a large yellow chalk line «СТУЛА?». No other words, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements.
job.style_qa: обложка: школьная доска, меловой рисунок стула, красный кружок вокруг болта, вверху надпись «САМАЯ ВАЖНАЯ ЧАСТЬ СТУЛА?» без ошибок, другого текста и логотипов нет
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. The title block centred horizontally with its middle around 25% from the top, fully inside the central 3:4 safe area (between 13% and 87% of the height); the chair drawing centred, its middle around 58% from the top.
